name: aegis-agent-os
description: Aegis Agent OS — self-hosted enterprise AI agents with Paperclip orchestration, Hermes-style operations, local LLM routing, and audit-first governance

scripts.build: npm run build -w @enterprise/shared && npm run build -w @enterprise/agent-runtime && npm run build -w @enterprise/security-layer && npm run build -w @enterprise/mcp-hub && npm run build -w @enterprise/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @enterprise/shared --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @enterprise/agent-runtime --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @enterprise/security-layer --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @enterprise/mcp-hub --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @enterprise/dashboard --if-present
scripts.dev: echo 'Run individual packages with: npm run dev -w @enterprise/<package>'
scripts.db:init: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U enterprise -d enterprise_agents -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-db.sql
